extDesc.message: Collect academic paper metadata, download PDFs, and create Obsidian Markdown notes.

extUnsupportedPage.message: Unsupported page: paper metadata could not be extracted.

extPdfSkipped.message: Markdown saved, but no PDF URL was found.

extPdfFailed.message: Markdown saved, but PDF download failed.

extPdfDisabled.message: Markdown saved without downloading the PDF.

extInvalidSavePath.message: Save directory must be a relative path inside the browser download directory.

optSavePathHint.message: Relative subfolder inside the browser download directory

optInvalidSavePath.message: Save directory must be a relative path inside the browser download directory.

optTagMappingsHint.message: Map paper categories to custom tags

optTemplateHint.message: Variables: title, authors, authors_wikilinks, year, venue, latest_year, latest_venue, preprint_year, preprint_venue, published_year, published_venue, publication_status, publication_timeline, tags, arxiv_id, doi, pdf_url, pdf_filename, pdf_link, web_url, abstract, safe_title, citation_count, note, bibtex, reading_assistant.

readerIntro.message: Understand methods, formulas and experiments, then explore the knowledge and research steps behind them.

readerExcerptHint.message: Paste a passage or LaTeX formula, or use selected text.

readerQuestionHint.message: Which assumption makes this step valid?

readerSendNotice.message: Analyze sends the passages shown above and your question to your configured model service. Nothing is sent automatically.

readerInclude.message: Include this analysis in the saved note

readerResultNotice.message: AI explanations may be incorrect. Check cited passages; proposed research steps require validation.

readerPartialContext.message: Only a selection of the loaded text will be sent. Conclusions may depend on omitted sections. PDF extraction is limited to 120 pages and documents to 240,000 characters.

readerKindUnknown.message: Not established by the supplied text

readerReady.message: Start with the abstract, load paper text, or choose a passage. Configure a model service before analysis.

readerTextReady.message: Paper text is ready. Check the source passages before analysis.

readerPdfReady.message: PDF text is ready. Check formulas and tables against the original; text extraction can omit symbols or reorder content.

readerImportedFile.message: Imported: $1. Confirm that this PDF belongs to the displayed paper.

readerSelectionReady.message: Selected text is ready. You can edit it or load more paper context.

readerAnalyzing.message: Analyzing the selected passages… You can cancel this request.

readerDone.message: Analysis is ready. Check the cited passages and choose whether to include it in your note.

readerCached.message: Loaded the cached analysis for this paper version, context and model.

readerInvalidEndpoint.message: Enter an HTTPS API base URL without credentials, query parameters or fragments. HTTP is allowed only for localhost.

readerMissingModel.message: Enter the model ID provided by your model service.

readerConfigureFirst.message: Open AI settings, enable reading analysis, and configure your endpoint and model.

readerNoText.message: No usable text is available. Load paper text, import a text-based PDF, or paste a passage.

readerNoSelection.message: Select a passage on the paper page, then click Use selected text. You can also paste it here.

readerInvalidResponse.message: The model returned an incomplete or invalid analysis. Try again or choose another model.

readerInvalidCitations.message: The model returned missing or unknown source citations. The analysis was not accepted; try again.

readerAuthFailed.message: The model service rejected authentication. Check the API key and account access in settings.

readerRateLimited.message: The model service rate or usage limit was reached. Wait and retry or check your account allowance.

readerServiceFailed.message: The model service could not complete the request. Check the endpoint and model, then retry.

readerTimeout.message: Analysis timed out after 90 seconds. Retry with a shorter passage or a faster model.

readerCancelled.message: Request cancelled. Your paper collection fields remain available.

readerNetworkError.message: Could not reach the model service. Check its URL, network connection and host permission.

readerPermissionNeeded.message: Host access was not granted. Save AI settings to authorize the model service, or retry loading the paper source.

readerSourceFailed.message: Could not read the paper source. Try importing its PDF or pasting a passage.

readerSourceTimeout.message: The paper source timed out. Retry or import the PDF from your computer.

readerFileTooLarge.message: Choose a PDF smaller than 25 MB.

readerPdfNoText.message: This PDF has no usable text layer. Scanned PDFs need OCR; paste recognized text to continue.

readerPdfFailed.message: This source could not be parsed as a PDF. Download the real PDF and import it, or paste text.

readerPageChanged.message: The active paper page changed. Refresh the collector before starting another analysis; refreshing clears unsaved edits.

readerStorageFailed.message: Could not save settings or cache. Check the browser storage and retry.

readingSettingsIntro.message: Optional AI analysis using your own OpenAI-compatible chat-completions service. Existing collection features work without it.

readingEndpointHint.message: Use your provider's base URL or full /chat/completions URL. HTTPS is required except for localhost services.

readingApiKey.message: API key (if required by your service)

readingKeyHint.message: Stored in this browser profile, not encrypted or synced by this extension. Only sent to the configured model endpoint when you click Analyze.

readingPrivacyHint.message: Only requested passages, paper metadata and your question are sent. Up to ten completed analyses are cached locally. Saving settings grants access only to the service origin you enter.

readerExcerptOnly.message: Use only this excerpt when one is provided

readerTopicHint.message: For example, robust evaluation with small samples

readerScreenHint.message: Uses the abstract when available. The topic is sent with this request and kept with its local result.

readerQuickHint.message: Uses the abstract when available. The card is written in Simplified Chinese.

readerExplainHint.message: Select text on the paper page or paste a passage or formula.

readerQaHint.message: Load paper text or import a PDF, then ask a question. Relevant passages are selected from the loaded text.

readerTopicRequired.message: Enter a research topic to screen this paper.

readerExcerptRequired.message: Select or paste the passage you want explained.

readerFullTextRequired.message: Load paper text or import a PDF before asking about the full text.

readerQuestionRequired.message: Enter a question about the paper.

readerTagsApplied.message: Added the selected tags to the paper.

extDiscardDraft.message: Discard the unsaved edits and reading work for this paper?

extSaveWhileAnalyzing.message: Save the current note and close before the analysis finishes?

extNoteInterrupted.message: The Markdown download was interrupted. Check Chrome Downloads and retry.

extNotePending.message: The Markdown download is in progress. Check Chrome Downloads for completion.

extPdfPending.message: Markdown saved. PDF download is still in progress. The note links to the online PDF.

readerPaperResumed.message: Back on the original paper. Your draft is ready.
